## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`), raw + spectral read

Both runs complete, no rails (sr1 ≤ 0.12 fs), gate currents at baseline. Raw first,
then the 1/B spectra. Frequencies quoted with the run-5 (n, D) calibration; F_full
= |n|·h/4e is the single-4-fold-Fermi-surface expectation (`luttinger_frequency`).

"""Runs 6-7 raw: sdh-spot-check Rxx(B) at D = 0 (run-5 cal): run 6 electron n = +3.2e12 (B 0 -> 10 T),
run 7 hole n = -1.2e12 (10 -> 0.3 T ride-down). sr1 50 uV, I = 10 nA; R from measured drain current."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel


def spot_trace(rid):
    r = run(rid)
    chs = resolve_channels(r.meta)
    cur = current_channel(chs)
    I = r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    v = [c for c in chs if not c.is_current and np.abs(r.col(c.col)).max() > 0][0]
    R = (r.col(v.col) / v.gain) / I
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], np.abs(R[o])


fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for a, (rid, lab) in zip(ax, ((6, "n = +3.2e12 (electron)"), (7, "n = -1.2e12 (hole)"))):
    B, R = spot_trace(rid)
    print(f"run {rid}: {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, |Rxx| {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm")
    a.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    a.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="|Rxx| (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} — {lab}, D = 0")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

"""SdH content of runs 6-7: per-tone low-B onsets (sdh_onset) + FFT in 1/B above 1 T.
Discriminator: tone count and frequency partition vs the full-density 4-fold Onsager
frequency F_full = |n| h / 4e (33.1 T at +3.2e12; 12.4 T at -1.2e12)."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for a, (rid, n12) in zip(ax, ((6, +3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    B, R = spot_trace(rid)
    F_full = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"===== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12 -> F_full(4-fold) = {F_full:.1f} T =====")
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
        print(so.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"sdh_onset failed: {e}")
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.0, B.max()), nfft=4096, log=False)
    sp = spec[0]
    sel = freqs > 2
    pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[sel], prominence=0.05 * sp[sel].max())
    pkf = sorted(((freqs[sel][p], sp[sel][p]) for p in pk), key=lambda t: -t[1])[:5]
    print("FFT peaks (T): " + ", ".join(f"{f:.1f}" for f, _ in pkf) + "\n")
    a.plot(freqs, sp, lw=0.8)
    a.axvline(F_full, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_full = {F_full:.1f} T")
    for f, amp in pkf[:4]:
        a.annotate(f"{f:.1f}", (f, amp), fontsize=8)
    a.set(xlabel="F (T)", xlim=(0, 60), ylabel="FFT amp", title=f"run {rid}: FFT in 1/B, B > 1 T")
    a.legend(fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

**Read (runs 6–7):** Both spot checks show rich SdH starting below ~1 T — a high-quality device.
**Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_full = 33.1 T):** one robust fundamental **F ≈ 7.4 T** (FFT 7.8, matched filter 7.1), alive down to the 0.3 T record edge, with pure 2×/3×/4× harmonics (14.1/22.2/29.5) and no independent tone near 25.6 or 33.1. At 4-fold degeneracy 7.4 T carries only ~0.7×10¹² of the 3.2×10¹² total — most of the density sits in a Fermi surface whose oscillations are not resolved at T_e ≈ 8 K (heavy-mass LK damping), or the low censored tones (3–5 T, edge-limited) are real subband pieces. Matches the ABAB light-band expectation (7.5 T at this n) with the heavy partner (25.6 T, m* ≈ 0.06) plausibly damped; does **not** match single-surface ABCA (33.1 T absent).
**Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_full = 12.4 T):** two **non-harmonic** tones **4.7 T** and **6.6 T** — sum 11.3 ≈ 0.91·F_full — plus a distinct 12.3 T tone ≈ F_full (total-density / magnetic-breakdown orbit, or their sum within resolution). A two-Fermi-surface hole side with frequencies summing to the total density: multiband, ABAB-like partition (predicted pair 5.3/7.1 T is within calibration + resolution of 4.7/6.6).
**Lean:** two-band Fermiology on both carrier signs → **ABAB-consistent, ABCA-disfavored**; ABCB not yet excluded (it also yields multiple surfaces). The discriminating measurement is F(n) + the LL gap sequence across the fan → run 8.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n × B, the stacking discriminator

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n fast -1.25..+3.25e12 141 pts (co-swept TG/BG, run-5 cal); B slow 1->10 T, 120 rows uniform-1/B; sr1 100 uV, I 10 nA; ends 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~12:56** (≈7h30m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`); operator-requested next move. The spot checks
(runs 6–7, ana cells 14–17) read multiband on both carrier signs — e-side F ≈ 7.4 T
matching the ABAB light band with the heavy partner unresolved, h-side pair
4.7 + 6.6 ≈ F_full — i.e. ABAB-consistent / ABCA-disfavored, ABCB open. The fan
resolves it: **F(n) family structure per gate column** (two parabolic-band families
summing to nh/4e → ABAB; a single nh/4e line → ABCA; a light ~√n monolayer-like
family → ABCB weight) plus the **LL gap sequence / crossing pattern** in (n, B).

**Design.** Fast axis: (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the calibrated D = 0 line
(run-5 cal), n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² cm⁻², 141 pts (Δn = 0.032×10¹²). Slow axis:
B = 1 → 10 T ascending (magnet sits at 0; opening ramp ~7 min), **120 rows uniform
in 1/B** — constant sampling per SdH period, per-column `sdh_fft`-ready with no
resample (F_Nyquist 66 T covers the 29.5 T 4× harmonic; window resolution 1.1 T
separates 22.2 (3×7.4) from a real 25.6 T partner). B < 1 T is already covered at
two densities by runs 6–7 at finer sampling. sr1 at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS): sized to the
high-B CNP stripe per the run-4 lesson; oscillation amplitudes (10–100 Ω) read at
0.1–1 % fs, demonstrated clean in runs 5–6.

**Coverage trade:** hole side reaches only n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) — the
hole fan is shallow; D = 0 only (a D ≠ 0 wedge is plan step 6, only if the call
stays ambiguous). Full hole-side coverage is not purchasable inside the committed
gate box.

**Checkpoints** (armed `hera-watch --next --follow`): first 3 rows — rail/leak/row
rate vs the 165 s/row prediction (run-5 per-point calibration, 1.17 s/pt); then
~hourly — partial fan re-form + per-column FFT; abort if the gate current trips,
sr1 rails over a wide n-band (not the CNP stripe), or rows run > 30 % over price.
Ends at **10 T with gates at 0**; the next step rides the field down.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n fast [-1.25, +3.25]e12 (141 pts) x B slow 1 -> 10 T (120 rows, uniform 1/B) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 141)          # 1e12 cm^-2 along D = 0; dn = 0.032e12
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 120)             # uniform in 1/B: d(1/B) = 0.00756 /T -> F_Nyquist 66 T, dF 1.1 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY, I_TRIP = 1.0, 3.0, 1e-9

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan opens with the 1 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# Fixed sensitivity: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (run-4 lesson: size to the worst corner,
# here the high-B CNP stripe; a nu=0 clip in a narrow n-window is accepted and stated in the md).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast dwell {FAST_DELAY} s")
print(f"n [-1.25, +3.25]e12 -> Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}] V, Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = "landau-fan D=0: n fast -1.25..+3.25e12 (141), B slow 1..10 T uniform-1/B (120 rows), run-5 cal, sr1 100 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: n fast [-1.25, +3.25]e12 141 pts (dn 0.032e12); B slow 1 -> 10 T 120 rows uniform in 1/B '
              f'(d(1/B) 0.00756 /T, F_Nyq 66 T); cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089e12, D_offset -0.013; '
              f'sr1 100 uV (10 kOhm FS), I = 10 nA')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (held for the next step), gates parked at 0")
